scope: Approved fixed stored-mode byte read trial A implementation, offline validation and separate downloadable tool. No charge-control implementation.

authorization.scope: Fixed one-shot read implementation, build, offline validation and tool provision; user starts the actual trial manually.

entryAndReservation.manualStart: Interactive START only; arguments and redirected input/output rejected.
entryAndReservation.elevation: asInvoker, no automatic elevation, no administrator retry requirement.
entryAndReservation.order: START -> new fixed-purpose durable claim -> read-only preflight -> fixed attempt -> SDK preparation -> at most one invocation -> actual close join.
entryAndReservation.reservation: Fixed per-user LocalApplicationData application Experiments location; CreateNew, WriteThrough and Flush(true); existing empty/corrupt marker consumes the trial; no repair/reset/delete/path/account fallback.
entryAndReservation.fixedSdkEntry: PrepareFixedReadAAsync accepts sealed attempt without arbitrary command/address/frame/timeout/dispatch arguments; attempt/plan/binding one-use checks retained.

fixedProfileAndRequest.platform: Windows10x64 only; manifest-aware major10 build10240 through21999.
fixedProfileAndRequest.metadata: Local fixed namespace/class/GUID/methodID1/in-outDataBuffer/Bytes UInt8[]; complete sole Active instance and actual SDK identity.
fixedProfileAndRequest.unknownOrMismatch: No method call; no alternate profile.
fixedProfileAndRequest.request: One source-matched fixed generic read branch and one stored mode byte; no arbitrary runtime input.
fixedProfileAndRequest.comparison: One standard RNG eight-byte fill; all-zero/failure abort before invocation; deterministic internal seam only in automated tests.

lifetime.joins: Same invocation RunAndClose and RequestClose; SDK call-exit, applicable terminal, detached capture, callbacks and owned inputs/owner close retained.
lifetime.callCanceled: Existing cancellation failure latch retained; not forwarded as actual terminal.
lifetime.unknown: Retain related references and wait without extra disposal or new calls. Some cleanup may already have happened; not a claim that every lease remains held.
lifetime.controlC: Prevent default termination and pass local stop intent only.
lifetime.journalFailure: Before Run, join close without calling; after invocation, preserve actual-close join and never retry.

acceptance.required: Method envelope, structural ACK/shape, failure-prefix rejection, control/tail/echo/preserved-address/eight-byte-content checks and candidate domain0or1.
acceptance.result: Sanitized stored-mode candidate only; raw frame, comparison content, paths, accounts, unique identifiers and exception text excluded.
acceptance.normalPlatformPremises: Normal proxy/private backend initialization, inline related typed handling and same initialized nonreentrant P05 stream; existing conditional ISA/bank/host-to-XDATA and whole-exchange contracts.
acceptance.reevaluateOn: Concrete related independent AP/direct/domain bypass, deferred indexed work or inapplicable normal registration/stream conditions.
acceptance.closedGate: May yield no sample; no handshake, retry or fallback.

rootVerification.restore: Final serial restore used existing clear-source test configuration and cached reference packages; no new dependency installed.
rootVerification.earlierRestore: Saved silent parallel-graph failure and initial online vulnerability-data unavailable warning; serial cache-only restore removed the network dependency. No warning suppression used.
rootVerification.crosswalkMeaning: New implementation literals compared with saved static proofs; no new firmware decode/execution, runtime frame generation or hardware discovery.
rootVerification.reservationTests: Temporary directories and separate objects/concurrent Tasks, not executed Windows cross-process or power-loss tests.

distribution.compiledBeforePublicationCommit: Product source fingerprint pins the actual build input; no claim of a build against the later publication commit ID.

review.hostPreflightReservationAndTestsIndepend: No blocking findings; final wording and post-preparation journal close-only branch applied.

artifactIndependentVerification.scope: Allowlist, CRC, checksums, four build-byte matches, source fingerprint, net48/x64/manifest/unsigned and bounded CLI metadata/IL call-site plus report-expression review. Not a hardware test or proof that all possible strings/paths/actors are absent.

review.finalDocumentationIndependentReadReview: No blocking findings; proposal approval, historical states, current validation, fixed limits, applicability premises and pending wording are consistent. Read-only review.

environment: No cloud configuration publication, driver/service/ACL/security/firmware flash changes or original binary execution.
privacy: Sanitized enums, bounded candidate and source/build hashes only. No local absolute paths, raw firmware contents, command/address pairs, frames, comparison content, identities or raw exception text.
